proven_features.code: score = 85; if score >= 90 then "A Grade" else if score >= 80 then "B Grade" else "C Grade" end end

proven_features.title: Boolean Logic Excellence

proven_features.code: make a function called greet { return "Hello from PaTLang!" }; call greet
proven_features.wow_factor: BREAKTHROUGH: Natural language function syntax that actually works!

proven_features.title: 🚀 Function with Parameters - AMAZING!
proven_features.code: make a function called multiply takes: x, y { return x * y }; call multiply with 7, 6
proven_features.wow_factor: Natural parameter passing - reads like English, works like code!

proven_features.title: 🚀 Function with Local Variables

proven_features.wow_factor: Functions with local variable scope working perfectly

proven_features.code: make a function called square takes: n { return n * n }; call square with 8
